name: ES Futures — Gap-Up Fill Probability (RTH)
description: Analyzes the historical probability of ES Futures (E-Mini S&P 500) price returning to touch the previous RTH session's high on gap-up open days (open > prior day high). Uses 30-minute intraday bars within the RTH session (09:30–16:00 ET). Computes overall fill rate, annual breakdown, timing distribution (within 1h, 2h, 3h, EOD), and average gap size split by filled vs unfilled.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES FUTURES — GAP-UP FILL PROBABILITY (RTH)
# =============================================================================
# Gap-Up = today's RTH open > previous RTH session high
# Fill   = session low <= previous RTH high at any point during the session
# Resolution: 30Min intraday bars
# RTH Session: 09:30–16:00 ET
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=30Min)()

# NoAdjustment preserves actual price levels for accurate session touch detection
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=30Min,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

high   = cont.h
low    = cont.l
open_p = cont.o
close  = cont.c

# === HOLIDAY FILTER ===
is_holiday = holiday(
    days_before=0,
    days_after=0,
    holiday_calendar=HolidayCalendar.CMEGlobexEquitiesHolidayCalendar
)

# === RTH SESSION WINDOW (09:30–16:00 ET) ===
rth_sw = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York')
)(open_p, high, low, close)

# Valid RTH session = session closed and not a holiday
rth_valid = (rth_sw.closed and not is_holiday)

# === EOD FILTER TRICK ===
# Divide by itself: 1.0 on valid EOD bars, NaN everywhere else.
# Multiplying any metric by eod_filter restricts its values to EOD bars only,
# so AggregationType.Mean across all bars = rate across sessions only.
rth_eod_flag = (1.0 if rth_valid else 0.0) / (1.0 if rth_valid else 0.0)

# === PREVIOUS DAY RTH HIGH ===
# Snapshot RTH high at EOD, shift by 1 bar into next session, ffill forward
prev_high_snapshot = where(rth_valid, rth_sw.high)
prev_hod = ffill(prev_high_snapshot >> 1)

# === TIME OF DAY (ET minutes since midnight) ===
bar_idx    = index()
bar_tod_et = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_idx)
bar_year   = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_idx)

# === GAP-UP DETECTION (at RTH open — first bar of the session) ===
# rth_sw.open is available throughout the session (session_window fills forward)
is_gap_up_bar = (rth_sw.open > prev_hod)

# Capture gap-up flag at EOD so each day = one data point
gap_up_eod = (1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar) else 0.0) * rth_eod_flag

# === FILL DETECTION ===
# On gap-up days, fill = session low touched or crossed below prev_hod
# Touch condition: rth_sw.low (running low during session) <= prev_hod
is_filled_eod = (
    1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod) else 0.0
) * rth_eod_flag

# === SESSION-LEVEL COUNT METRICS ===
# Total sessions analyzed
total_sessions = (1.0 if rth_valid else 0.0) * rth_eod_flag

# Gap size in points (open - prev_hod), only on gap-up days
gap_size_raw = rth_sw.open - prev_hod

# Gap size on filled days
gap_size_filled   = where(rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod, gap_size_raw)
# Gap size on unfilled days
gap_size_unfilled = where(rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low > prev_hod, gap_size_raw)

# === TIMING: WHEN DOES THE FILL OCCUR? (intraday bar-level) ===
# For gap-up days, flag each 30Min bar where it is the FIRST bar that touches prev_hod.
# We detect if low <= prev_hod at each 30Min bar (during RTH only, gap-up days only).
#
# RTH 30Min bar time_of_day (ET minutes):
#   09:30 =  570  (bar 1)
#   10:00 =  600  (bar 2)  -> 1h boundary = bar 2 close (10:00–10:30 open)
#   10:30 =  630  (bar 3)  -> within 1h = touched by end of bar 2 (bar_tod <= 600)
#   11:30 =  690  (bar 5)  -> within 2h = bar_tod <= 690
#   12:30 =  750  (bar 7)  -> within 3h = bar_tod <= 750
#   rest of day up to 16:00 = 960

# Is this bar a gap-up session bar where price touches prev_hod?
is_touch_bar = (is_gap_up_bar and (not is_holiday) and (low <= prev_hod) and rth_sw.opened)

# At EOD, compute which time bucket the first touch fell in by checking cumulative
# session minimum — session_window tracks the running low already via rth_sw.low.
# To determine WHEN the touch happened, we use bar-level timing buckets.
# Approach: on each 30Min bar, record if the running low has just crossed for the first time.
# We approximate timing by checking the session low at fixed intraday sub-windows.

# Sub-window session windows to check cumulative low by time bucket
sw_1h = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='10:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(open_p, high, low, close)

sw_2h = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(open_p, high, low, close)

sw_3h = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='12:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(open_p, high, low, close)

# At EOD of each day, did the sub-window low touch prev_hod?
low_by_1h = ffill(where(sw_1h.closed, sw_1h.low))
low_by_2h = ffill(where(sw_2h.closed, sw_2h.low))
low_by_3h = ffill(where(sw_3h.closed, sw_3h.low))

# Timing flags (mutually exclusive buckets, EOD-restricted, gap-up + filled days only)
# gap-up fill filter
gap_up_filled_filter = (
    (1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod) else 0.0)
    / (1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod) else 0.0)
)

touched_within_1h = (
    1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod and low_by_1h <= prev_hod) else 0.0
) * gap_up_filled_filter

touched_1h_to_2h = (
    1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod
            and low_by_1h > prev_hod and low_by_2h <= prev_hod) else 0.0
) * gap_up_filled_filter

touched_2h_to_3h = (
    1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod
            and low_by_2h > prev_hod and low_by_3h <= prev_hod) else 0.0
) * gap_up_filled_filter

touched_after_3h = (
    1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod
            and low_by_3h > prev_hod) else 0.0
) * gap_up_filled_filter

# === ANNUAL BREAKDOWN ===
# Year label (at EOD for each session)
year_label = bar_year * rth_eod_flag

# Annual gap-up fill rate: use gap-up filter to restrict
# Cast bar_year (Integer) to Decimal via * 1.0 to prevent type mismatch
bar_year_f = bar_year * 1.0
gap_up_filter_eod = gap_up_eod / gap_up_eod

# Fill rate per gap-up day (for xy_bars annual chart — label=year, value=fill_flag)
fill_flag_per_gap_up_day = (
    1.0 if (rth_valid and is_gap_up_bar and rth_sw.low <= prev_hod) else 0.0
) * gap_up_filter_eod

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. SUMMARY CARDS ---
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='ES Gap-Up Fill — Key Statistics',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, title='Total RTH Sessions'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, title='Gap-Up Days (Open > Prev High)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, title='Gap-Up Fills (Touched Prev High)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='Overall Fill Probability %'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Avg Gap Size — Filled (pts)'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Avg Gap Size — Unfilled (pts)')
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary'
)(total_sessions, gap_up_eod, is_filled_eod, fill_flag_per_gap_up_day, gap_size_filled, gap_size_unfilled)

# --- 2. ANNUAL FILL RATE BAR CHART ---
xy_bars(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Annual Gap-Up Fill Rate (%) — Open Above Prev RTH High',
    y_axis_label='Fill Rate',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    x_axis_label='Year',
    category='2. Annual Breakdown',
    vertical=True,
    data_labels=True,
    border_radius=0.1,
    color_by_value=False,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[BarSeriesSpec(name='Fill Rate', color=Color.Sky)])
)(fill_flag_per_gap_up_day, year_label)

# --- 3. YEAR-BY-YEAR SUMMARY TABLE ---
# 5 columns per year row: Gap-up count, Fill count, Fill rate, Avg gap filled, Avg gap unfilled
# We use standard mode: one row per metric across the full period
# For the year-by-year table we use RowSpec GROUP BY mode: grouping_key=year
# This gives: rows = metric types, cols = years (but years are variable count)
# Instead, use a flat table showing per-year stats using the label+agg pattern
# We pass 3 values that will be aggregated per year via AggregationType on the year label

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Year-by-Year Gap-Up Fill Statistics',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Total RTH Sessions',
            'Gap-Up Days (Open > Prev RTH High)',
            'Gap-Up Fills (Touched Prev High)',
            'Fill Rate (%)',
            'Avg Gap Size — All Gap-Up Days (pts)'
        ],
        col_headers=['All Years Combined'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, title='Total Sessions'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, title='Gap-Up Days'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, title='Fills'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, title='Fill Rate'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Avg Gap (pts)')
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Detail Table'
)(total_sessions, gap_up_eod, is_filled_eod, fill_flag_per_gap_up_day, gap_size_raw)

# --- 4. TIMING DISTRIBUTION TABLE (of gap-up fills) ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Fill Timing Distribution — When Does Price Touch Prev High?',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=[
            'Within 1st Hour (by 10:30 ET)',
            '1st–2nd Hour (10:30–11:30 ET)',
            '2nd–3rd Hour (11:30–12:30 ET)',
            'After 3rd Hour (12:30–16:00 ET)'
        ],
        col_headers=['Share of Fills', 'Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Fill Timing'
)(
    touched_within_1h, touched_within_1h,
    touched_1h_to_2h, touched_1h_to_2h,
    touched_2h_to_3h, touched_2h_to_3h,
    touched_after_3h, touched_after_3h
)

# --- 5. GAP SIZE HISTOGRAM (all gap-up days) ---
histogram(
    title='Gap Size Distribution — Gap-Up Days (Open – Prev RTH High, in Points)',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Gap Size (Points)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    category='5. Gap Size',
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1
)(gap_size_filled)
